description: This file defines the implementation of the 'Lib' class within the 'gfxstream' namespace, which handles dynamic library loading and symbol resolution using dlopen, dlclose, and dlsym. It includes methods for loading a library, closing it, and retrieving symbols.

classes.name: Lib
classes.description: A class that manages dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, and library closing functionalities within the 'gfxstream' namespace.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a shared library specified by its name and returns a 'Lib' instance if successful, or an error string if loading fails.

methods.name: GetSymbol
methods.description: Retrieves the address of a symbol within the loaded library by name.

inner_classes.name: LibraryCloser
inner_classes.description: A functor class that closes a library handle when invoked.

methods.name: Lib::LibraryCloser
methods.description: A functor for closing a dynamically loaded library handle.

methods.name: Lib::Load
methods.description: Loads a library by name, returning a 'gfxstream::expected' containing the 'Lib' object or an error message.

methods.name: Lib::GetSymbol
methods.description: Gets the address of the specified symbol within the loaded library.
